articles.titleEn: UK inflation rises to 3.6% as petrol and diesel prices climb
articles.summary: Higher fuel prices pushed UK inflation up from 3.5% in September to 3.6% in October. Diesel hit a record high, while prices for food and non-alcoholic drinks rose at their slowest pace in five years.
articles.summaryEn: Higher fuel prices pushed UK inflation up from 3.5% in September to 3.6% in October. Diesel hit a record high, while prices for food and non-alcoholic drinks rose at their slowest pace in five years.
articles.body:
